guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Special (Marley) / Fender Stratocaster (Marvin)
guitar.notes: Marley famously played a Gibson Les Paul Special (and also Washburn/Ovation acoustics at times); this is reasonably well known, keeping medium confidence is fair given some variation.

tone.target: bright clean reggae skank with slight edge
tone.profile: bright clean reggae skank with slight edge
tone.summary: A classic reggae skank tone achieved using a clean Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) combined with light compression for punch and subtle room reverb to add space.

rig.name: Bob Marley - Three Little Birds - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythmic chops.
Add punch and sustain to the muted upstroke skank, enhancing rhythmic tightness.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is ideal for reggae's percussive nature.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and avoid heavy crunch or overdrive.
blocks.gap: The 'None' setting is used to bypass any drive effect, maintaining maximum cleanliness.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean Fender/JC style amp required for classic reggae tones.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the closest model to a clean American tweed or JC-style sound available in the catalog.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright and focused cabinet sound suitable for clean single-coil guitar tones.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is chosen for its brightness, complementing the US Deluxe amp model.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the bright single-coil snap and cut out excessive low end for tight rhythmic chops.
blocks.gap: A slight boost in treble is crucial for that characteristic reggae 'snap'.

blocks.purpose: Avoid the use of wah or filtering effects as per the musical verdict.
blocks.gap: The 'None' setting ensures no unwanted frequency shaping occurs.

blocks.purpose: Avoid modulation effects like chorus or tremolo.
blocks.gap: The 'None' setting is used to bypass any unwanted modulations.

blocks.purpose: Add very light room ambience to give the tone space without muddying the tight rhythm.
blocks.gap: The 'Room' reverb is perfect for adding subtle, natural space as requested.
Used as a final master volume control.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall brightness with a dedicated IR.

proposals.recommendedAsset: bright clean reggae IR (e.g., Fender Twin)
proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, open sound needed for skank rhythm.
